title: The Niche Down Framework: The positioning playbook nobody prints
caption:
The positioning playbook nobody prints

The old way vs. what actually works now:
1️⃣ Pick one pain — Not a demographic — a 3am problem. 'Cold emails that get replies,' not 'marketing.'
2️⃣ Name the before/after — Write the state they're in now and the state you deliver. That's your ad.
3️⃣ Kill adjacent offers — Every extra service halves your message. One offer is louder than five.
4️⃣ Speak to it for 30 days — Same pain, same audience, every post. Measure replies, not views.
